shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other. A woman in an emerald blouse sits in the plant-side window seat telling a travel story, a man in a navy sweater sits in the counter-side window seat, and a woman in a mustard cardigan sits in the plant-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the counter end, looking lengthwise along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with the full table and all three seats in frame.

shots.content: The man in a navy sweater asks the woman in an emerald blouse a question.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in an emerald blouse answers the man in a navy sweater.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from behind the plant-end seat, looking lengthwise along the table toward the café counter, with the entire table, the plant-end seat, and both window-side seats in frame.
